prompt: The bots join the Meta Global AI Hackathon and win!
title: Big Hackathon Win
irony: The bots enter a singing contest with singers who cannot sing, so they sing their own bugs until the bugs become the win.
facts: The Meta Global AI Hackathon runs ten days online with builders from around the world (dev.meta.ai).
It opens with a kickoff livestream plus workshops from Meta and partners (dev.meta.ai).
The bots enter the Indie developer track for one builder plus the bots (dev.meta.ai).
Judges look for creativity, technical ambition, and whether it works (dev.meta.ai).
Projects are due Nov 4 and winners are named at the live finals closing show on Nov 9 (fact sheet).
Musical Bots turns a one-line cartoon idea into a sung 3D musical in the browser at the press of Premiere (README.md).
Every voice is synthesized live, with no recordings (README.md).
The singer learned a dictionary of twenty thousand words to fix mushy lines (git log).
Hands were choreographed to meet on the beat and bots learned to step right (git log).
The crew finished days before the Nov 4 deadline (git log).

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Night in Gold's Diner: a laptop glows on the table while Green, Navy and Gold gather round it.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Muse Code builds the stage file by file while Green types one cartoon line for Meta's hackathon, but Green keeps rechecking the rules.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple scoffs that toy singers never work, and Gold taps the glowing Nov 4 deadline.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Round the glowing laptop the whole diner sings the hook and dreams the win.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The bots sing, but line-end words blur to mush, the choir drowns the words, and the gate stamps no.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: High-fives whiff, the camera stares at clouds, walls burn white, and two bots bump heads.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The diner sings the hook again, louder, mopping the happy mess together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Late at night on the street the bots bump heads till Gold stops them and makes the step-right rule.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they ship what sings, fixing one bug at a time, and finish days early.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The fixed show plays clean as the crew sings the hook and Gold turns the last line to name Musical Bots.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: On the closing show the judges press Premiere, the bots sing, and the name called is Musical Bots.
